name: Resistor Environment QA 28
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Effective resistance in a complex resistor network

examples.input: What is the effective resistance between A and D for the circuit with following topology {"resistors": {"R1": "R", "R2": "R", "R3": "R", "R4": "R", "R5": "R"}, "connections": [["A", "B", "R1"], ["A", "B", "R2"], ["B", "C", "R3"], ["C", "D", "R4"], ["C", "D", "R5"]]}?
